_source: Sampled by `bun packages/ui-mac/test-fixtures/engine-adapter-sampler/sample.ts` (alpha-code#1668 L6) at e1c8e7e046: a real OpenCode 2 engine from this repo's packages/cli `serve`, isolated HOME/XDG, one git project, and the scripted OpenAI-compatible mock model next to the sampler. Event table cases: every /api/event frame (with the message page read right after it) from a sequence that creates, runs, renames and deletes sessions, renames the project, creates / renames / lets exit / deletes a pty, switches the git branch, connects the local mock-mcp.ts (oauth off), has it announce tools / resources / prompts list_changed and then disconnects it, adds a project reference and reloads the location, and cancels a question form. `sessions` = GET /api/session/:id for every session id seen, read at the end; `serverConnected` = the subscription's first frame. lsp.updated and global.disposed have no publisher in this engine and cannot be sampled.
